entities.summary: Noel Fernando Salas Buitimea is a Mexican professional baseball pitcher for the Olmecas de Tabasco of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the St. Louis Cardinals, Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim, New York Mets, Arizona Diamondbacks, and Philadelphia Phillies. He made his MLB debut with the Cardinals in 2010.
